description: Bevy web framework layer — src/main.rs with a real App, DefaultPlugins, camera, light, and a rotating cube driven by a system.

buildHints.whenToUse: Rust-first game or interactive 3D content that must run in the browser. Bevy supplies an ECS, PBR renderer, input, and audio; Trunk handles the WASM build and asset pipeline. Choose this over a JS-based framework when the logic is inherently systems-based or you want Rust's type safety across the whole codebase.
firstSteps: Install the toolchain once: `rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown` then `cargo install --locked trunk`.
Run `trunk serve` — it compiles Rust to WASM, runs wasm-bindgen, and opens http://localhost:8080 with hot-reload on Rust file changes.
The Bevy app is in `src/main.rs`: DefaultPlugins + a Camera3dBundle, DirectionalLight, AmbientLight, and a rotating cube. Start replacing the cube with your geometry and adding systems.
Run `trunk build --release` to emit a production bundle in `dist/` — deploy to any static host.
gotchas: `wasm-bindgen-cli` must match the version in Cargo.lock. Always install with `--locked`; version drift causes cryptic `imported memory` linker errors.
WebGPU is Chrome/Edge 113+ and Safari 18+; Firefox stable falls back to WebGL2. Guard any WebGPU-only features behind a capability check.
WASM binaries are large by default (~10–20 MB debug, ~3–6 MB release). Always ship `trunk build --release`, which runs wasm-opt -Oz automatically.
Assets loaded via `AssetServer` are fetched relative to the HTML page. Files must be under `public/` (Trunk copies them to `dist/`) — dropping assets next to `src/` causes 404s at runtime.
architectureNotes: One `App::new()` per process — Bevy is not reentrant. All plugins, systems, and resources attach to that single app.
Systems are stateless functions operating on queries and resources. State belongs in `Resource`s or `Component`s, not in system-local variables across frames.
Keep WASM-specific code under `#[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]` so the crate also builds natively for fast iteration without a browser.

placeholders.description: Minimal Bevy app: DefaultPlugins, Camera3dBundle, DirectionalLight, AmbientLight, and a PbrBundle cube with a per-frame rotation system. Replace the cube mesh and material with real geometry, add input and audio systems, or swap DefaultPlugins for a narrower plugin group to reduce bundle size.
